_comment: User-global Claude Code hooks. Goes at ~/.claude/settings.json. Project-specific overrides go in <project>/.claude/settings.json.

hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" ] && command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.md|*.css|*.html) prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; fi; if [ -f "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" ] && command -v black >/dev/null 2>&1; then case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.py) black -q "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; fi

case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.ts|*.tsx) if [ -f tsconfig.json ] && command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then ERR=$(npx -y tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1 | grep "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | head -5); [ -n "$ERR" ] && echo "TypeScript errors in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:" && echo "$ERR"; fi ;; esac

CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm -rf (/|~|\$HOME)' || echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git push.*--force.*(main|master)' || echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'DROP DATABASE|TRUNCATE TABLE' || echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'supabase.*--db-url.*prod'; then echo 'BLOCKED: dangerous command. Ask Roman first.' >&2; exit 2; fi
case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.env.production|*.env.prod|*/secrets/*) echo 'BLOCKED: do not edit production secrets without explicit Roman approval.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

if [ -d .claude/plans ]; then LATEST=$(ls -t .claude/plans/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$LATEST" ] && echo "Active plan: $LATEST"; fi; if [ -d .git ]; then echo 'Git status:'; git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -20; fi
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude finished" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Glass"' 2>/dev/null || true
